metadata.name: ocrmypdf
metadata.summary: Add an optical character recognition (OCR) text layer to scanned PDF files

content.value: OCRmyPDF adds a searchable optical character recognition (OCR) text layer to scanned PDF files and images, making them easy to search or copy and paste from. Utilizing the powerful Tesseract OCR engine, it processes documents across multiple CPU cores to ensure rapid, dependable, and privacy-preserving conversions.
Designed for archival stability, it generates validated PDF/A documents and can perform lossless insertions without disrupting existing document content or degrading image resolution.

items.value: Generates searchable, standard-compliant PDF/A files from standard PDFs or images
Leverages Tesseract OCR engine to recognize more than 100 languages
Deskews, cleans, and corrects page rotation prior to optical character recognition
Accurately places OCR text underneath original images to enable clean copying and pasting
Optimizes embedded images while preserving original resolution to reduce output file size
Distributes processing across all available CPU cores to handle documents with thousands of pages
